anya (CISO): Hi team — before we start the POC we need a short compliance packet: audit exports to our Splunk HEC, KMS-backed key handling, a roster of POC users, and an example of immediate key revocation plus the resulting audit entry. POC = 60 days, ~250 rps.

sam (AE): Thanks @anya. Tagging @leo and @zoe to confirm. Splunk HEC + 1y retention preferred.

leo (Sales-Eng): Hosted + HEC forwarding is quickest. Dedicated pool can be done if you need isolation but adds ~5 business days. Pricing estimate depends on expected tokens/sec.

zoe (Solutions): We can forward audit events to Splunk HEC (preferred) or S3 (KMS encrypted) for long-term retention. Default in-platform retention = 90 days; your S3 can hold 12 months.

anya (CISO): Splunk HEC preferred. I'll DM the endpoint and token. Need a field-level spec for SIEM mapping.

zoe (Solutions): Field spec will include: event_type, actor, actor_email, key_id, action, resource, result, timestamp, audit_event_id, metadata. Sample sanitized event: {"event_type":"api_key.create","actor":"ops@acme","key_id":"k_01","action":"create","timestamp":"2026-04-02T11:02:03Z","audit_event_id":"ae_1001"} (we'll provide JSONL file).

policy-bot: provision-request created id=prov-3344 type=dedicated-temp ETA=40m

leo (Sales-Eng): For revocation proof: we'll give curl example and a sanitized audit entry showing revocation_time and audit_event_id. Example revoke curl:

curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/keys/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin>" -d '{"key_id":"k_01"}'

Response event example: {"event_type":"api_key.revoke","actor":"ops@acme","key_id":"k_01","timestamp":"2026-04-02T11:05:10Z","audit_event_id":"ae_1002","details":"revoked via console"}

anya (CISO): Great. Also need a roster template (CSV) with name, email, role (console/api). Minimum two engineers and one security lead.

zoe (Solutions): We'll drop a roster CSV template and a short statement on KMS integration + key rotation policy. Expect sanitized sample JSONL and field spec in ~2 hours after you DM creds.

sam (AE): Scheduling a 15-min security walkthrough tomorrow 9am PT to go over artifacts. @anya please accept the invite.

policy-bot: provision completed id=prov-3344 status=success pool_id=dedicated-3344 ephemeral=true

anya (CISO): Accepted the invite. I'll DM HEC creds and roster this afternoon. Thanks everyone.

leo (Sales-Eng): Sending a pro-rata POC quote to your inbox after this thread.

zoe (Solutions): Action items: anya -> HEC + roster; zoe -> field spec + JSONL sample + KMS note; leo -> quote; sam -> schedule. We'll close after the walkthrough. :white_check_mark:
